teaching.hint: How many positions are occupied by all the numbers having the same decimal length?

solution_outline.decisive_insight: Numbers of equal digit width form blocks whose total length can be counted without constructing the sequence.
solution_outline.approach: Subtract complete digit-width blocks until the target position falls inside one. Divide the remaining zero-based offset by that width to locate the number, then use the remainder to locate its digit.
solution_outline.state_and_invariant: At every step the remaining position is relative to the first unskipped digit-width block; completed blocks contribute exactly their counted digits.
solution_outline.correctness: Every integer appears once in increasing order, and quotient/remainder uniquely locate the number and digit inside the surviving block.
solution_outline.complexity: O(log n) time and O(1) auxiliary space; block counts require wide integers.
solution_outline.pitfall: Mixing 1-based input with zero-based division puts positions at block boundaries in the wrong number.

common_wrong_turns: Build the concatenated sequence up to n
source_fidelity_notes: The 1-based index and lack of separators are explicit; a compact boundary example is retained.
